summary: @servicetitan/html-sketchapp preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") is an obfuscated dropper. setup.mjs uses obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming and per-function string dictionaries to hide its behavior: it detects OS/arch/libc (parsing /etc/os-release, checking for musl), downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmod+x's the bun binary, then execFileSync's it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) containing a heavily obfuscated string-array/dispatcher construction with ~2000 constants — opaque bytecode-style content unrelated to HTML-to-Sketch conversion. The alternate-runtime choice (Bun) is an evasion technique so Node-based scanners do not evaluate the payload. This dropper is absent from the upstream brainly/html-sketchapp project and is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose. Result: `npm install @servicetitan/html-sketchapp` executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
